title: How the Pro‑Nicotine “Wellness” Movement Rebranded an Addictive Drug - Nautilus
gist: Wellness influencers, podcasts and tech startups are rebranding nicotine—via tobacco-free pouches and blends with caffeine and nootropics—as a focus-enhancing, cognitively protective 'clean' product, an ironic trend alongside the Make America Healthy Again movement.

insights.claim: Influencers, wellness communities and tech startups are repositioning nicotine from an addictive tobacco-linked substance into a natural performance product for focus and protection against cognitive decline.
insights.speaker: Hasmeena Kathuria
insights.so_what: Demand tailwind for nicotine-pouch and nootropic brands, with regulatory and reputational risk attached.
insights.quote: nicotine is being repositioned from an addictive substance linked to tobacco use to a natural product that can be used for everything from improving focus to protecting against cognitive decline
